|game_text=Deploy on Han. I've Got a Bad Feeling About This is canceled. When fired, Han is cumulatively power +1 until end of turn. May target a character or creature for free. Draw destiny. Target hit, forfeit = 0 and opponent loses 1 Force if destiny +1 > defense value.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Han's Blaster, So Uncivilized]]; it is the current text. No published card image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB8-03-Hans_Blaster_So_Uncivilized-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-hansblastersouncivilized-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-03-Hans_Blaster_So_Uncivilized.png]]) show the original text (see [[Han's Blaster, So Uncivilized]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Han's Blaster, So Uncivilized]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 July 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on Han. I've Got A Bad Feeling About This is canceled. When fired, Han is cumulatively power +1 until end of turn. May target a character or creature for free. Draw destiny. Target hit, its forfeit = 0 and opponent loses 1 Force if destiny +1 > defense value.” The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-hansblastersouncivilized-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-03-Hans_Blaster_So_Uncivilized.png]]) print it. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 54) prints this text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) dropped “its” (“Target hit, forfeit = 0”)<ref name="cl-1281_46-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); the same text in the captures of 12 December 2012 and 11 January 2013</ref>: “Deploy on Han. I've Got a Bad Feeling About This is canceled. When fired, Han is cumulatively power +1 until end of turn. May target a character or creature for free. Draw destiny. Target hit, forfeit = 0 and opponent loses 1 Force if destiny +1 > defense value.” (The Virtual Block 8 list of 21 July 2012 and the Virtual Master list (VMasterType, 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11) spell it “cancelled”; the Virtual Block 8 list from 12 December 2012 has “canceled” again. That spelling-only difference waits for a ruling, so it is not a separate version.) No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB8-03-Hans_Blaster_So_Uncivilized-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
